pr_title: [Feature][PCP][MM] Support multimodel reasoning when prefill context parallel feature is on
source_quote:
We should move the code above into `PCPManager` and call the function before calling `ModelRunner._preprocess`. This way, we won't need to modify `_preprocess`.
Move the following code into `PCPManager` and call these functions like
if self.pcp_size <= 1:
self._gather_mm_embeddings(xxx)
else:
self.pcp_manager._gather_mm_embeddings(xxx)
Our primary goal is to reuse as much of the vLLM code as possible and minimize inheritance-based modifications, thereby reducing maintenance costs. Additionally, we should migrate PCP-related code to `PCPManager` as much as possible to facilitate reuse by `ModelRunnerV2`.

rule.description: 对于需要在 ModelRunner 中添加的平台特定功能（如 PCP），应将相关逻辑封装到独立的 Manager 类（如 `PCPManager`）中，而不是直接修改 ModelRunner 的方法。这样可以最大限度地复用 vLLM 上游代码，降低维护成本，并便于在 ModelRunnerV2 中复用。
